name: Barlow Twins
tagline: Pushes the cross-correlation matrix between two views toward identity, encouraging invariance and decorrelation.
formula: $$C_{ij} = \frac{\sum_b z^A_{b,i} z^B_{b,j}}{B},\quad \mathcal{L} = s\Big[\sum_i (1 - C_{ii})^2 + \lambda \sum_{i\neq j} C_{ij}^2\Big]$$
diff_from_baseline: Zbontar et al., ICML 2021 (Barlow Twins: Self-Supervised Learning via Redundancy Reduction). Drives the cross-correlation matrix between two augmented views' embeddings toward the identity; standalone anti-collapse SSL objective without teacher/student or EMA.

name: Naive (MSE only)
tagline: MSE invariance loss with no anti-collapse term; the trivial baseline that demonstrates representation collapse.
diff_from_baseline: Lower-bound baseline used internally by this benchmark. Optimizes invariance only with no variance/covariance/decorrelation penalty - representations collapse to a constant, providing the reference floor for anti-collapse methods.

name: SIGReg (BCS)
tagline: Penalises non-Gaussianity of random 1-D projections of embeddings via Epps-Pulley characteristic-function distance, plus MSE invariance.
pseudocode:
1. Sample N=256 random unit projections $u_k \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I)/\|\cdot\|$
2. Project both views: $v^A = z^A U,\; v^B = z^B U$
3. For each slice, compute empirical characteristic function $\widehat{\phi}(t) = \mathbb{E}[e^{itv}]$ on a 10-point grid in $[-3,3]$
4. Epps-Pulley statistic $T_k = \int e^{-t^2/2} |\widehat{\phi}_k(t) - e^{-t^2/2}|^2 dt$
5. BCS = mean(T(view A)) + mean(T(view B)) all divided by 2
6. Total loss = MSE($z^A,z^B$) + 10 * BCS
diff_from_baseline: Skorski & Bardes 2024 (SIGReg / Batched Characteristic Slicing). Replaces variance/covariance penalties with a Gaussianity test on random 1-D projections, which scales better in high dimensions while still preventing collapse.

name: VICReg
tagline: Variance + Invariance + Covariance regularization: hinge-on-std variance term, MSE invariance, and off-diagonal decorrelation.
diff_from_baseline: Bardes, Ponce & LeCun, ICLR 2022 (VICReg). Three-term SSL objective combining invariance, per-dimension variance hinge, and off-diagonal covariance decorrelation - canonical SSL anti-collapse baseline.
